desc: By default (strict) the end-of-turn check blocks once on each new claim problem, so the agent fixes or acknowledges it before finishing; a meaning change is shown to the user as a notice and never blocks by itself; problems that existed when the session started don't block, and relaxed mode only reports.

history.desc: By default (strict) the end-of-turn check makes the agent fix or acknowledge claim problems before finishing; relaxed mode only reports them.

By default (strict) the end-of-turn check blocks once on each new claim problem or meaning change, so the agent fixes or acknowledges it before finishing; problems that existed when the session started don't block, and relaxed mode only reports.

By default (strict) the end-of-turn check blocks once on each new claim problem, so the agent fixes or acknowledges it before finishing; a meaning change is shown to the user as a notice and never blocks by itself; problems that existed when the session started don't block, and relaxed mode only reports.
history.why: user feedback: the Stop hook asks the agent to "tell the user" about meaning changes it had already reported, which costs an extra turn

mentions.anchor: report problems at the end of a turn, don't block
fix or acknowledge new problems before finishing (default)
| Stop | whole-project check; new problems block once (strict) or are reported (relaxed); a meaning change is shown to you as a notice and never blocks by itself |
| End of turn | only **new** problems, top 5; blocks at most once each. A meaning change is shown to you, not sent back to the agent |
